units.source_text: 意思是说，在实战中，常常是风云变幻，突然爆出一些无法预料的战局而决定命运。

en.t: In other words, in actual play, the situation often changes unpredictably, and some unforeseen turn in the game may suddenly erupt and decide the outcome.
White 130 belonged precisely to this kind of situation.

units.source_text: 对弈者的运筹帷幄，外行人自不消说，就是专业棋手的估计，都因这一手而立即落空。

en.t: The players' careful strategizing, needless to say for outsiders, and even the estimates of professional go players, were all instantly overturned by this one move.
